response:
FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something peculiar. The king, a stout and regal figure with a thick beard, is pacing back and forth in front of a grand, ornate mirror.

KING (he) addresses his trusted advisor, a bespectacled wizard named ZORVATH (he).

KING
(to Zorvath)
I have a vision, my friend. A vision of a new era for our empire. An era of... of... (he searches for the right words)...of futurism.

ZORVATH
(skeptical)
Futurism, Your Majesty? But we are in the Middle Ages.

KING
(nodding)
Exactly! We must break free from the shackles of tradition. We must... we must... (he gestures grandly)...we must vaporwave our aesthetic!

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king, surrounded by his courtiers and advisors, begins to unveil his vision. He dons a sleek, neon-lit crown, and his armor is replaced with a shimmering, iridescent jumpsuit.

KING
(to his courtiers)
Behold! The future of our empire!

COURTIER 1 (she)
(stunned)
Your Majesty, what... what have you done?

KING
(smiling)
I have vaporwaved our aesthetic, my friends. I have brought the future to our doorstep.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is transformed. The buildings are now sleek, futuristic structures with neon lights and holographic advertisements. The knights are replaced with robots, and the peasants are now dressed in futuristic, high-tech attire.

KING
(to Zorvath)
See? I told you it would work.

ZORVATH
(sarcastically)
Yes, Your Majesty. It's a... a... (he searches for the right words)...a bold new direction.

KING
(nodding)
I know, I know. But trust me, my friend. This is the future. This is the way of the vaporwave.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king, surrounded by his courtiers and advisors, is now lounging on a plush, velvet couch, sipping a futuristic, glowing drink.

KING
(to his courtiers)
Now, let us celebrate our new era. Let us... let us... (he gestures grandly)...let us rave!

COURTIER 2 (he)
(excitedly)
Yes, Your Majesty! Let us rave!

The courtiers and advisors all cheer and begin to dance, surrounded by holographic projections and futuristic, pulsating lights.

KING
(smiling)
This is it, my friends. This is the future. And I am the king of the vaporwave.

FADE TO BLACK.
